figures.shows: The sub-scenes part of the result of scene.loadStatus in a running game, after scene.loadAdditive loaded a small scene into it
figures.caption: The sub-scene entry of the status: its number, the asset handle of the scene it loaded, its state, its progress, the entities created and skipped, and the number of slices that created them.
figures.alt: A block of JSON text with one entry for a sub-scene. It shows sub-scene number 1, the scene's asset handle, state Loaded, progress 1.0, 7 of 7 entities created and none skipped, 1 slice, and an error that is null.
